Game Overview
New Angeles is a political game in which four to six players 
assume the roles of the megacorporations of the Android 
universe. The players cut deals and forge temporary alliances 
to gain leverage and financial superiority over their corporate 
rivals, all while trying to maintain order and profitability in 
their home city of New Angeles.
